sentences.text:
This is first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with the Crime No.95/2023,
registered at Police Station Bherugarh, District Ujjain for the offence punishable under Section 409,
420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B read with 34 of IPC, Section 7 (c), 13(1) (a) and 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and Section 66 C of Information Technology Act, 2000.
Learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this Misc. Criminal Case with liberty to file afresh after completion of investigation.
With the aforesaid liberty, Misc. Criminal Case is dismissed as withdrawn, however, Investigating Officer is directed to complete the investigation as early as possible.
